newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 9.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
China says it will delay by one month a plan to ban imports of some U.S. goods in retaliation for American penalties on purchases of Chinese textiles.
The China Securities Regulatory Commission issues a circular ordering institutions to strengthen risk control in the securities market.
The Ministry of Electronics Industry forecasts sales of personal computers will hit 40 billion yuan in 1997.
Chen Jinhua, minister in charge of the State Planning Commission, says further adjustments to China's economic structure will be essential to maintaining economic stability.
Vice-premier and economic tsar Zhu Rongji meets former U.S. Secretary of State Henry Kissinger and exchanges views on Sino-U.S. relations and other issues.
